title: Mona's Merge Maze
description: Eat commits. Dodge bugs. Find your way to a clean deploy.
instructions: Collect every commit to open the exit. Use the game's own theme, music and effects buttons. On touch devices, movement buttons appear after starting. Scroll inside the game to reach all of its controls.

title: Flappy Copilot
description: One tiny Copilot. An endless pipeline. Keep the build airborne.
instructions: Flap through the gaps and keep going. Click or tap the game first to give it keyboard focus. Your score and audio belong to the game, not the cabinet.

title: Mona Breaker
description: Break commits. Squash bugs. Merge the pull request.

controls.action: Move the paddle on touch screens

instructions: Break every commit square to merge the pull request. Catch Copilot, Dependabot and Actions power-ups and dodge falling bugs. The game pauses when it loses focus; press Space or P to resume. Use the game's own theme, music and effects buttons.

title: Mona Crossing
description: Dodge bugs. Ride commits. Get Mona home to five main gardens.

controls.action: Hop one tile; hold to repeat
Start; Enter resumes or replays from the playfield
Start a fresh game with three hearts
Tap to hop; hold to repeat

instructions: Dodge bug traffic and ride commit logs and pull-request ferries to five main gardens. You have three hearts and 40 seconds per crossing. Click or tap the playfield to give it keyboard focus. Leaving the game pauses it; resume explicitly. Sound effects start off and your sound setting and best score are saved locally. Use the game's own controls and scroll inside it to reach the D-pad and How to cross help.
